claimCollateral(uint256,uint8).details: Clears the defaulted side's lockId from registry.       Emits LockPendingRelease — multisig MUST then call       EWBWhaleVault.unlockMintingRights(defaultedLockId) directly.       The non-defaulted side's lock is also released via       LockPendingRelease so the pool is fully unwound.

createPool(address,address,uint256,uint2.details: INV-3: partyA != partyB enforced here.       INV-4: ltv capped at LTV_MAX (9999 bps).

params.deadlineSec: Repayment window in seconds after pool opens. 0 = 30 days.
params.ltv: LTV in basis points (1–9999). 0 = use 800 default.
params.partyA: Side A address — must be whitelisted
params.partyB: Side B address — must be whitelisted, != partyA

depositInterest(address,uint256,uint256,.details: Called AFTER repayCredit(). The multisig has received USDC         off-chain from the borrower. The interest slice is deposited         here and tracked in pendingInterest[token].         CEI: state written before external transferFrom call.

params.amount: Interest amount in token decimals (USDC = 6 dec)
params.poolId: Pool ID this interest relates to (for audit trail)

drawCredit(uint256,uint256).details: Party A draws against Side B's lock; Party B against Side A's.       INV-5: amount cannot exceed available credit on opposing side.

params.amount: Credit units to draw (6 decimals, same scale as faceValueUSD)

returns.swept: Lifetime amount swept to router (token decimals)

markDefault(uint256,uint8).details: INV-6: Requires drawnCredit > 0 — can't default on zero draw.       Requires repaid == false.

params.side: 0 = Side A defaulted, 1 = Side B defaulted

paused().details: Returns true if the contract is paused, and false otherwise.

repayCredit(uint256,uint8).details: If drawnCredit > 0: records repayment + interest accrued.       Interest amount is added to totalInterestAccrued (informational).       Actual USDC must be deposited separately via depositInterest().       If drawnCredit == 0: records a waive (distinct event).       Both paths mark the side repaid so the pool can close.       When both sides repaid/waived, emits LockPendingRelease       for each lockId — multisig MUST call WhaleVault separately.

params.side: 0 = Side A's obligation, 1 = Side B's obligation

seedPool(uint256,uint8,uint256).details: INV-1: lockId 0 always rejected.       INV-2: lockId cannot already be assigned to any pool.       lockIdToPoolId is written AFTER all validation — not before.       Pool opens automatically when both sides seeded.

setRevenueRouter(address).details: Callable any time by multisig — allows router upgrade without         redeploying this contract. Emits event for audit trail.

sweepInterestToRouter(address).details: INV-8: only moves tokens actually held by this contract.         Calls routePrivatePoolInterest() on the router — that function         must be added to EWBRevenueRouter (see amendment note below).         Reverts if router not set, nothing pending, or balance too low.         CEI: state cleared before external transfer.

createPool(address,address,uint256,uint2.notice: Create a pool and assign both parties.

depositInterest(address,uint256,uint256,.notice: Multisig deposits the interest portion of a repayment into         this contract so it can be swept on-chain to the revenue router.

drawCredit(uint256,uint256).notice: Draw internal credit against the opposing side's collateral.

interestSweepStatus(address).notice: Preview pending interest for a given token without sweeping.

markDefault(uint256,uint8).notice: Mark a side as defaulted after the repayment deadline.

pendingInterest(address).notice: Interest deposited by multisig and awaiting sweep (USDC 6 dec)

repayCredit(uint256,uint8).notice: Multisig confirms repayment for one side.

revenueRouter().notice: Address of EWBRevenueRouter — set by multisig after deploy

seedPool(uint256,uint8,uint256).notice: Seed one side of the pool with a WhaleVault minting lock.

setRevenueRouter(address).notice: Set or update the EWBRevenueRouter address.

sweepInterestToRouter(address).notice: Sweep all accumulated interest for a given token to the         EWBRevenueRouter, which records it as private pool income         and forwards to the SPV treasury.

totalInterestAccrued().notice: Running total of interest accrued across all repaid pools (informational).

totalInterestSwept(address).notice: Total interest swept to revenue router per token (lifetime)
